test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the volume (in cm³, rounded off to two decimal places) of a hemispherical cap having a radius of 33.6 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Radius** (r) = 33.6 cm

**Volume of Hemisphere** = (2/3) × π × r³

Direct Calculation: (2/3) × π × (33.6)³ = (2/3) × 37933.056 × π

⇒ 25288.704 π

**∴ The correct answer is 25,288.70π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Radius** (r) = 33.6 cm

**Formula Used:** **Volume of a Hemisphere** = (2/3) × π × r³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4af9415f95221763399992bcf4a4a70df319700e4356422259ac0f9f55658a5f.png] 

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × (33.6) × (33.6) × (33.6)

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × π × 37933.056

⇒ Volume = 2 × π × 12644.352

⇒ Volume = 25288.704π

⇒ Rounded to two decimal places: 25288.70π

**∴ The correct answer is 25,288.70π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Hemisphere

**Curved Surface Area** (CSA) = 2πr² and **Total Surface Area** (TSA) = 3πr².

Volume of a Sphere

A **hemisphere** is exactly half of a sphere. **Volume of full Sphere** = (4/3)πr³.

Unit Conversion

1 **Litre** = 1000 cm³. To convert volume in cm³ to litres, divide the value by 1000.</p
